title: Local Functions
summary: `local function name()` declares a function scoped to its block — faster to call and invisible outside. The default way to write helper functions in Roblox scripts.

syntax:
local function heal(character, amount)
    character.Humanoid.Health += amount
end

details.heading: Recursion needs forward declaration
details.body: `local function f()` cannot call itself during its own definition. For recursion, declare first: `local f; f = function(...) ... f(...) ... end`.

explanation.whatItIs: A function declared with `local`. It exists only from the declaration to the end of its block — other scripts, and code above the declaration, can't see it.
explanation.whyItExists: Same benefits as local variables: no global pollution, typo safety, and faster calls (register access instead of `_G` lookup).
whenToUse: For essentially every function you define in a script
Helpers used by one module: keep them local, export only the API
whenNotToUse: There's almost no reason to write bare `function name()` in Roblox code — linters flag it
explanation.mentalModel:
```text
local function helper()   -- lives only in this script
end

helper()                  -- fine
```
Elsewhere: `helper` would be nil.
tips: Declare helpers near the top of the script, main logic below — reads like a table of contents
In modules, local functions are your private implementation; the returned table is the public API
commonMistakes: Calling a local function above its declaration — it's nil there
Writing `local function f()` then trying to reassign `f` — that's fine, but `local function` declares a fresh local; don't confuse it with updating an existing one

examples.title: Private helper in a module
examples.code:
local CoinSpawner = {}

-- private: only this module can see it
local function randomPosition()
    return Vector3.new(math.random(-50, 50), 10, math.random(-50, 50))
end

-- public: exported in the returned table
function CoinSpawner.spawn(count)
    for i = 1, count do
        local coin = Instance.new("Part")
        coin.Name = "Coin"
        coin.Position = randomPosition()
        coin.Parent = workspace
    end
end

return CoinSpawner
